name: com.haruchanz64.melody-recognition-engine
description: Real-time Burst-compiled humming and acoustic instrument melody recognition engine for Unity 6. Features YIN/MPM pitch tracking, Hum & Instrument DSP profiles, relative-interval & absolute-pitch matching, unlockable song repertoires, Guided/Learn Mode, player-recorded custom songs, an optional uGUI Musical Staff HUD, and a UI Toolkit Melody Workbench.

samples.description: 6-song demo showcasing Hum Mode, Instrument Mode, virtual button fallback, Guided/Learn Mode, custom song recording, and the uGUI Musical Staff HUD.
Maps Unity Input System actions or keyboard keys into DiscreteNoteInputSource for accessible non-microphone play.
Connects recognized melodies to CommonEventsEngine events/switches and adds custom commands to unlock or teach songs.
